evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Delivered as a constitutive rule — an identity-level equivalence that defines what counts as having a rollback at all, stated with the permanence of a creed rather than argued for.
A cadence set and recorded as operational — the settling is performed in the scheduling itself, not merely argued for.
An owner is assigned, ratifying the decision with a named accountable party — the settling is performed through the assignment.

mints.name: UnrehearsedEquivalence
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting an identity-level equivalence that defines what counts as having a capability at all?
